newsitem.title: DUBAI: U.S. couple murdered in Saudi Arabia.
newsitem.headline: U.S. couple murdered in Saudi Arabia.

text.p: A U.S. couple has been murdered at a housing compound in the Saudi capital Riyadh where many American families live, a statement circulated by the compound to residents said on Monday.

"It was confirmed today (Monday) by the U.S. embassy that there was a criminal incident last night at the King Khaled International Airport (KKIA) compound," said its superintendent John Davis in a statement, a copy of which was obtained by Reuters.
"Our understatnding of the matter is as follows: an American couple was murdered by one of the husband's co-workers. The couple did not have children in Saudi."
"The incident was a criminal act, not a terrorist act," he added.
The statement did not disclose the identity of the victims and did not give the nationality of the suspect who it said was in police custody.
